items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Clyde asked me would I like to make some records with him.

ctx.x: That's Clyde's contact and Clyde's record date.

Yeah. Well, see, I didn't know that was going to be a commercial record. Clyde asked me would I like to make some records with him. You know, why not? But I thought he was just getting it for his own amusement, doing it for his own amusement, for himself, you know. So I told him, sure, I'd make some records with him. I thought maybe he was making some demos or something.

So when I get to the studio and we get through with the recordings, then they hand me an envelope. I said, 'What is this?' 'That's what you get for making the recbrds.' I said, 'Well, I wasn't expecting to be paid for this.' I didn't know this was a commercial gig.' He said, 'Well, now ...(?)...(?)...' That's how he got, you know, the record (?).
